records: XRP Insights exchange balances are a secondary wallet-attribution series: raw balances are read from XRPL via rippled account_info, but exchange attribution depends on XRPSCAN public labels and has not been independently reproduced.

The 22.48B XRP exchange-wallet total includes cold storage, hot wallets, unclassified wallets and known non-customer reserves/funds; it is not tradable float, order-book depth, customer liabilities or proprietary exchange treasury.

The 487.2M XRP identified as non-customer reserves/funds comprises 325.8M Binance-Peg reserve, 150.2M Coinbase cbXRP reserve and 11.2M insurance/charity; other custody classifications may remain incomplete.

The all-exchange 7-day same-wallet decline of 133.0M XRP cannot distinguish customer withdrawals from exchange transfers to wallets not yet labelled; XRP Insights stores daily exchange totals, not per-wallet history.

The October 30 all-exchange daily same-wallet decline of 207.3M XRP was followed by a +105.9M same-wallet increase on October 31; this weakens any simple attribution of the October 30 decline to the Binance theft.
XRP Insights reports Binance same-wallet changes of +17.6M XRP over 7 days and +30.3M over 30 days. CryptoQuant and XRP Insights use different wallet universes and must remain separate series.

The prior 2.58B Binance balance observation is not reconciled to the current 2.78B XRP Insights wallet total. It may reflect a narrower reserve series or historical label/snapshot differences; no 200M inflow is inferred.

Binance Recovery Update #3's minimum 1:1 XRP coverage statement remains a company claim pending the full public zero-knowledge proof and independent same-time reserve-address/customer-liability reconciliation, estimated by Binance for November 3.
Binance's 90% aggregate recovery statement does not disclose XRP-specific purchase units, USD amounts, spot/OTC split or funding source; it is not evidence of XRP market demand.
The latest derivatives OI providers remain non-comparable (TradRadar about 1.86B across seven exchanges versus Kodexius about 738.99M across seven contracts); no composite OI feature is admitted.

ETF flow reports for October 30 are partial and conflict by provider/fund universe: CryptoETF reports +0.2M USD from 3/5 funds while CryptoKeyhole reports -1.412M USD from 3/4; no complete daily net-flow feature is admitted.

BNY, Aviva, C2FO, Coinbase/RLUSD and Ripple National Trust Bank announcements establish institutional infrastructure or product access, not XRP spot purchases or proven XRP collateral balances; some capabilities remain planned, subject to approval or waitlist.
191 open PRs include 181 drafts and 10 ready; 189 target main and 2 target another base. No bulk rebase, merge or closure was performed.
Cross-analysis and scheduler workflows remain write-capable on main; the Databricks token workflow still accepts a token input and attempts secret mutation. Proposed safety changes remain unmerged.
Full repository CI, dependency vulnerability scanning and branch-protection details remain incomplete; security-alert and branch-protection reads returned 403.
Only ChatGPT and the GitHub connection are verified active. Claude, Grok, Gemini, Copilot, Codex, Hugging Face, Kaggle and Databricks are not authenticated as live collaborators.
